watchParty.theHost.description: Roku Watch Party: stand-in for the host's name when the host has no display name. Used inside sentences such as banners and hints, so it reads as a noun phrase.

watchParty.entry.watchParty.description: Roku: label of the entry button that opens Watch Party from a title's page.

watchParty.entry.suggest.description: Roku: label of the entry button that lets a guest suggest the current title to the party they are in.

watchParty.entry.lobbyOnly.description: Roku: message shown when someone tries to start a title from outside the party lobby. Titles can only be suggested from the lobby.

watchParty.menu.open.description: Roku: menu item that opens Watch Party when no party is active.

watchParty.menu.return.description: Roku: menu item that goes back to the lobby of the party the user is already in.

watchParty.page.eyebrow.description: Roku: small all-caps heading above the headline on the Watch Party start page.

watchParty.page.headline.description: Roku: large two-line headline on the Watch Party start page. The line break is intentional.

watchParty.page.body.description: Roku: short intro paragraph on the Watch Party start page explaining that playback stays in sync for everyone.

watchParty.page.host.description: Roku: small all-caps label above the card for hosting a party on the start page.

watchParty.page.join.description: Roku: small all-caps label above the card for joining an existing party on the start page.

watchParty.page.start.description: Roku: button that creates a new Watch Party where the host picks the title.

watchParty.page.startVote.description: Roku: button that creates a new Watch Party where all members vote on the title.

watchParty.page.joinWithCode.description: Roku: button on the start page that opens the code entry screen to join someone's party.

watchParty.page.checkAgain.description: Roku: button that retries the check for Watch Party support after it failed.

watchParty.page.checking.description: Roku: status text on the start page while the app checks whether the server supports Watch Party.

watchParty.page.unavailable.description: Roku: message on the start page when the server or current profile cannot use Watch Party.

watchParty.page.starting.description: Roku: loading text shown while a new party is being created.

watchParty.rejoin.title.description: Roku: button to rejoin a recent party. {title}: the name of the movie or show the party was watching.

watchParty.rejoin.recent.description: Roku: heading or button label for rejoining a party the profile recently left.

watchParty.rejoin.continueHere.description: Roku: confirm button when rejoining a party that is active on another device.

watchParty.rejoin.takeOver.description: Roku: warning under the rejoin button. Rejoining on this device kicks the same profile off the party on its other device.

watchParty.code.title.description: Roku: title of the screen where the user types a party code.

watchParty.code.body.description: Roku: instruction on the code entry screen. Party codes are 8 characters long.

watchParty.code.join.description: Roku: short button on the code entry screen that submits the typed code.

watchParty.code.joinParty.description: Roku: button on the code entry screen that joins the party with the entered code.

watchParty.code.joining.description: Roku: button or status text shown while the code is being checked and the party joined.

watchParty.code.delete.description: Roku: on-screen keypad key that deletes the last typed character of the code.

watchParty.title.description: Roku: screen title for Watch Party.

watchParty.connection.hostAway.description: Roku: short status pill in the lobby, shown to guests when the host has lost connection.

watchParty.connection.open.description: Roku: short status pill in the lobby meaning the party is open and waiting for others to join.

watchParty.connection.here.description: Roku: short status pill in the lobby giving how many members are connected. {count}: the number of members connected.

watchParty.connection.connecting.description: Roku: short status pill in the lobby while first connecting to the party.

watchParty.connection.reconnecting.description: Roku: short status pill in the lobby while the connection is being restored.

watchParty.connection.disconnected.description: Roku: short status pill in the lobby when the party connection is lost.

watchParty.codePill.label.description: Roku: small all-caps label beside the party code in the lobby, read as 'join with ABCD1234'. Also read aloud by the screen reader before the code.

watchParty.options.button.description: Roku: lobby button that opens the party options dialog.

watchParty.hero.upNext.description: Roku: all-caps eyebrow on the lobby hero when a title is chosen but not yet started.

watchParty.hero.nowWatching.description: Roku: all-caps eyebrow on the lobby hero when the title is playing for the party.

watchParty.hero.youChose.description: Roku: caption on the lobby hero saying the current user picked the title.

watchParty.hero.hostChose.description: Roku: caption on the lobby hero. {host}: the host's display name.

watchParty.hero.hidden.description: Roku: placeholder title on the lobby hero when the chosen title is hidden from this profile.

watchParty.hero.loading.description: Roku: placeholder title on the lobby hero while the chosen title's details load.

watchParty.hero.open.description: Roku: all-caps eyebrow on the lobby hero for a party that is open but has no title chosen yet.

watchParty.hero.pick.description: Roku: two-line headline on the lobby hero shown to the host before a title is chosen. The line break is intentional.

watchParty.hero.pickCaption.description: Roku: caption under the host's 'pick something' headline in the lobby. Tells the host friends can already join with the code.

watchParty.hero.waiting.description: Roku: two-line headline on the lobby hero shown to guests before a title is chosen. {host}: the host's display name. The line break is intentional.

watchParty.hero.waitingCaption.description: Roku: caption under the guests' waiting headline in the lobby. {host}: the host's display name.

watchParty.hero.voting.description: Roku: all-caps eyebrow on the lobby hero while members vote. Counts the suggested titles being voted on; {count}: the number of titles.

watchParty.hero.voteTitle.description: Roku: headline on the lobby hero while members vote on what to watch.

watchParty.hero.voteCaption.manager.description: Roku: caption in the voting lobby shown to the host or manager, who starts the title currently leading.

watchParty.hero.voteCaption.guest.description: Roku: caption in the voting lobby shown to guests. {host}: the host's display name.

watchParty.banner.unavailable.manager.description: Roku: warning banner in the lobby shown to the host when the chosen title is not available to this profile.

watchParty.banner.unavailable.guest.description: Roku: warning banner in the lobby shown to guests when the chosen title is not available to their profile. {host}: the host's display name.

watchParty.banner.hostAway.description: Roku: warning banner in the lobby when the host's connection dropped. {host}: the host's display name.

watchParty.banner.reconnecting.description: Roku: banner in the lobby while this device is reconnecting to the party.

watchParty.seats.title.description: Roku: all-caps heading above the list of members currently in the lobby.

watchParty.presence.nobody.description: Roku: short lobby status line beside the member list when no members are connected.

watchParty.presence.onlyYou.description: Roku: short lobby status line beside the member list when the current user is the only one connected.

watchParty.presence.ready.description: Roku: lobby status line counting members who marked themselves ready. {ready}: how many are ready; {total}: how many members are connected (the plural counts this).

watchParty.presence.watching.description: Roku: lobby status line counting members currently watching. {watching}: how many are watching; {total}: how many members are connected (the plural counts this).

watchParty.seat.host.description: Roku: small tag on the host's row in the member list.

watchParty.seat.you.description: Roku: small tag on the current user's own row in the member list.

watchParty.seat.notReady.description: Roku: lowercase status on a member's row meaning they have not marked ready.

watchParty.seat.reconnecting.description: Roku: lowercase status on a member's row meaning their connection dropped and is coming back.

watchParty.seat.buffering.description: Roku: lowercase status on a member's row meaning their video is buffering.

watchParty.seat.syncing.description: Roku: lowercase status on a member's row meaning their playback is catching up to the party.

watchParty.seat.joining.description: Roku: lowercase status on a member's row meaning they are still joining.

watchParty.seat.invite.description: Roku: button at the end of the member list that shows the invite code.

watchParty.button.returnToPlayback.description: Roku: lobby button that goes back to the video already playing for the party.

watchParty.button.returnToLobby.description: Roku: button that sends every member back to the lobby from playback.

watchParty.button.startWinner.description: Roku: lobby button that starts the winning vote. {title}: the name of the movie or show.

watchParty.button.startForEveryone.description: Roku: lobby button that starts the chosen title for all members.

watchParty.button.suggestTitle.description: Roku: lobby button that opens the picker to suggest a title to the party.

watchParty.button.suggest.description: Roku: short lobby button to suggest a title.

watchParty.button.chooseTitle.description: Roku: lobby button that opens the picker so the host can choose a title.

watchParty.button.changeTitle.description: Roku: lobby button that reopens the picker to replace the chosen title.

watchParty.button.chooseSomethingElse.description: Roku: lobby button shown when the chosen title is unavailable, to pick a different one.

watchParty.button.imReady.description: Roku: lobby button where a member marks themselves ready to start.

watchParty.button.youreReady.description: Roku: lobby button label after the member marked ready. Shown with a small 'tap to undo' line.

watchParty.button.tapToUndo.description: Roku: small lowercase hint under the 'You're ready' button; selecting it clears ready.

watchParty.hint.suggestToStart.description: Roku: hint line in the voting lobby shown when no titles have been suggested yet.

watchParty.hint.noVotes.description: Roku: hint line in the voting lobby when there are suggestions but no votes.

watchParty.hint.everyoneReady.description: Roku: hint line in the lobby when all members have marked ready.

watchParty.hint.notReady.oneName.description: Roku: hint line shown to the host. {first}: the display name of the one member who has not marked ready.

watchParty.hint.notReady.twoNames.description: Roku: hint line shown to the host. {first}: name of one member not ready; {second}: name of the other member not ready.

watchParty.hint.notReady.moreNames.description: Roku: hint line shown to the host when three or more members are not ready. {first}: name of one such member; {second}: name of another; 'and others' covers the rest.

watchParty.hint.hostStartsWinner.description: Roku: hint line shown to guests in a voting lobby. {host}: the host's display name; {title}: the name of the leading movie or show.

watchParty.hint.hostStartsTheWinner.description: Roku: hint line shown to guests in a voting lobby. {host}: the host's display name.

watchParty.hint.hostStarts.description: Roku: hint line shown to guests in a lobby. {host}: the host's display name.

watchParty.ballot.votes.description: Roku: all-caps vote tally on a suggested title in the voting lobby. {count}: the number of votes it has.

watchParty.ballot.addTitle.description: Roku: label of the card in the suggestions list that opens the picker to suggest a title.

watchParty.ballot.addCaption.description: Roku: small caption under the add-a-title card telling members that any member may suggest titles.

watchParty.ballot.note.description: Roku: a note a member attached to a suggestion, shown in quotation marks. {note}: the note text typed by the member.

watchParty.ballot.startThis.description: Roku: button on a suggestion that lets the host start that title right away.

watchParty.ballot.remove.description: Roku: button on a suggestion that removes it from the list.

watchParty.strip.title.description: Roku: all-caps heading of the suggestions strip in the lobby. {count}: the number of suggestions.

watchParty.strip.manager.description: Roku: caption of the suggestions strip for the host or manager, who can queue a suggestion to play next.

watchParty.strip.guest.description: Roku: caption of the suggestions strip for guests; they can suggest but only the host picks.

watchParty.error.suggestionsSaved.description: Roku: error message in the lobby. The user's change succeeded but the refresh failed. {error}: the error detail from the server, sometimes empty.

watchParty.error.suggestionsRefresh.description: Roku: error message in the lobby when the suggestions list failed to refresh. {error}: the error detail from the server, sometimes empty.

watchParty.invite.eyebrow.description: Roku: small all-caps heading on the invite dialog.

watchParty.invite.title.description: Roku: title of the invite dialog, which shows the party code.

watchParty.invite.body.description: Roku: explanation on the invite dialog saying who can use the code.

watchParty.invite.scan.description: Roku: line beside a QR code on the invite dialog, which opens the invitation on a phone.

watchParty.picker.select.description: Roku: title of the title picker when the host chooses what to play.

watchParty.picker.suggest.description: Roku: title of the title picker when a guest suggests a title.

watchParty.picker.search.description: Roku: button in the picker that opens search.

watchParty.picker.close.description: Roku: button that closes the title picker.

watchParty.picker.continueTogether.description: Roku: picker row heading listing titles the party could continue watching.

watchParty.picker.watchlists.description: Roku: picker row heading for titles on members' watchlists.

watchParty.picker.recentMovies.description: Roku: picker row heading for newly added movies.

watchParty.picker.recentSeries.description: Roku: picker row heading for newly added TV series.

watchParty.picker.emptyTitle.description: Roku: heading shown when the picker has no titles to offer.

watchParty.picker.emptyBody.description: Roku: hint under the empty picker heading.

watchParty.picker.searchPrompt.description: Roku: placeholder text in the picker's search field.

watchParty.picker.noResults.description: Roku: heading shown when a picker search finds nothing.

watchParty.picker.noResultsBody.description: Roku: hint under the no-results heading in the picker.

watchParty.episodes.choose.description: Roku: all-caps heading of the episode picker when the host chooses an episode.

watchParty.episodes.suggest.description: Roku: all-caps heading of the episode picker when a guest suggests an episode.

watchParty.episodes.empty.description: Roku: message in the episode picker when the selected season has no episodes.

watchParty.episodes.reload.description: Roku: button in the episode picker that reloads the list after an error.

watchParty.episodes.line.description: Roku: short season and episode label on an episode card. {season}: the season number; {episode}: the episode number.

watchParty.confirm.together.description: Roku: all-caps eyebrow on the title confirmation page when starting a title together.

watchParty.confirm.suggest.description: Roku: all-caps eyebrow on the title confirmation page when suggesting a title.

watchParty.confirm.addSuggestion.description: Roku: button on the confirmation page that adds the title as a suggestion.

watchParty.confirm.choose.description: Roku: button on the confirmation page that sets the title as the party's pick.

watchParty.confirm.playForEveryone.description: Roku: button on the confirmation page that starts the title for all members.

watchParty.confirm.allEpisodes.description: Roku: button on a series confirmation page that opens the episode list.

watchParty.whoSeen.checking.description: Roku: status text on the confirmation page while members' viewing history loads.

watchParty.whoSeen.title.description: Roku: heading of the confirmation page section listing which members have seen the title.

watchParty.whoSeen.watched.description: Roku: a member's status in the who's-seen-it list: they finished the title.

watchParty.whoSeen.inProgress.description: Roku: a member's status in the who's-seen-it list: they started but did not finish.

watchParty.whoSeen.notWatched.description: Roku: a member's status in the who's-seen-it list: they have not watched it.

watchParty.whoSeen.noHistory.description: Roku: status in the who's-seen-it list when no history is available for that member.

watchParty.whoSeen.watchlist.description: Roku: a member's status line in the who's-seen-it list when the title is on their watchlist. {state}: their watch status, such as Watched or Not watched.

watchParty.whoSeen.error.description: Roku: error text in the who's-seen-it list when history failed to load. {error}: the error detail from the server, sometimes empty.

watchParty.options.title.description: Roku: title of the party options dialog.

watchParty.options.whoChooses.description: Roku: section heading in the options dialog for how the next title is chosen.

watchParty.options.everyoneVotes.description: Roku: option in the options dialog: members vote on the next title.

watchParty.options.hostChooses.description: Roku: option in the options dialog: only the host picks the next title.

watchParty.options.playbackControls.description: Roku: section heading in the options dialog for who may control playback.

watchParty.options.guestsPlayPause.description: Roku: option in the options dialog: guests can play and pause for everyone.

watchParty.options.hostOnly.description: Roku: option in the options dialog: only the host can control playback.

watchParty.options.returnToLobby.description: Roku: button in the options dialog that sends every member back to the lobby.

watchParty.options.end.description: Roku: destructive button in the options dialog that ends the party for all members.

watchParty.options.leave.description: Roku: button in the options dialog for leaving the party while it continues for others.

watchParty.options.close.description: Roku: button that closes the options dialog.

watchParty.end.confirmTitle.description: Roku: question title of the confirmation dialog for ending the party.

watchParty.end.confirm.description: Roku: destructive confirm button in the end-party dialog.

watchParty.player.reconnecting.description: Roku: on-screen notice during playback while the party connection is restored.

watchParty.player.syncing.description: Roku: on-screen notice during playback while this device catches up to the party.

watchParty.player.hostOnlySeek.description: Roku: brief on-screen notice shown when a guest tries to seek but only the host may.

watchParty.player.hostOnlyPlayPause.description: Roku: brief on-screen notice shown when a guest tries to play or pause but only the host may.

watchParty.player.waitingForClock.description: Roku: playback notice when synchronized timing from the party has not arrived yet.

watchParty.player.versionUnavailable.description: Roku: playback error when the media version the party chose cannot be played on this device.

watchParty.player.notAllowed.description: Roku: playback notice when a requested action, such as pausing, is not permitted by the party's settings.

watchParty.ended.ended.description: Roku: message shown when the party was ended by the host.

watchParty.ended.replaced.description: Roku: message shown on this device when the same profile joined the party elsewhere, taking over.

watchParty.ended.expired.description: Roku: message shown when the party connection expired or the party is gone.

watchParty.error.alreadyInParty.description: Roku: error shown when joining while already in another party.

watchParty.error.notFound.description: Roku: error shown when the entered party code matches no party.

watchParty.error.unavailable.description: Roku: error shown when the server version is too old to support synchronized Watch Party playback for this profile.

watchParty.error.recentElsewhere.description: Roku: error shown when trying to rejoin a recent party that belongs to a different server, account or profile.

watchParty.error.generic.description: Roku: generic fallback error for Watch Party actions.

watchParty.error.network.description: Roku: error for Watch Party actions when the server could not be reached.

watchParty.error.forbidden.description: Roku: error when a guest attempts an action reserved for the host.

watchParty.error.full.description: Roku: error when adding a suggestion fails because the suggestion list is at its limit.

watchParty.error.supportCheck.description: Roku: error on the start page when the support check failed. {error}: the error detail, sometimes empty.

subtitle.trackUnsupportedFormat.description: Android: secondary line under a subtitle track in the subtitle picker (player and detail page, phone and TV). Marks a track that is listed but cannot be selected because the app cannot display its format.

account.downloads.count.description: Android phone: count of offline downloads on the Accounts and Change account screens, also inside other sentences. {count}: the number of downloads.

account.profiles.count.description: Android phone: count of profiles on an account card on the Accounts and Change account screens. {count}: the number of profiles.

account.downloads.description: Android phone: row label on an account's page for its offline downloads.

account.downloads.none.description: Android phone: value of the Downloads row on an account's page when it has no downloads.

account.downloads.value.description: Android phone: value of the Downloads row on an account's page. {downloads}: the download count, such as 12 downloads; {size}: the total storage size, such as 8.4 GB.

account.fallbackName.description: Android phone: stand-in used in place of an account's username when it has none, in sentences such as sign-out questions and cards. Must read as a noun phrase.

account.needsSignInFooter.description: Android phone: footer note on an account's page when its session expired. Downloads are kept on the device.

account.profiles.description: Android phone: row label on an account's page for its profiles.

account.server.description: Android phone: row label on an account's page for the server it belongs to.

account.signInAgain.description: Android phone: button on an account whose session expired, to sign in again.

account.signOut.downloads.description: Android phone: warning line in the sign-out confirmation dialog, also shown when replacing an expired account. {downloads}: the download count, such as 12 downloads; {size}: the storage size, such as 8.4 GB.

account.signOut.question.description: Android phone: title of the sign-out confirmation dialog. {account}: the account's username; {server}: the server's display name.

account.signOut.removeServer.description: Android phone: destructive confirm button that signs out of the last account and also removes the server from the app.

account.username.description: Android phone: row label on an account's page for the sign-in username.

app.name.description: The app's name, shown on both phone and TV. Brand name, normally not translated.

bufferingQuality.autoLimited.description: Android phone and TV: Auto row of the player's Quality menu while the app is holding Auto at a lower quality after repeated buffering. Keep short; the TV menu is cramped.

bufferingQuality.cantLower.description: Android phone and TV: short notice in the player when buffering persists but no lower quality is available for this video.

bufferingQuality.lowered.description: Android phone and TV: short notice in the player saying the app automatically reduced video quality because of buffering.

bufferingQuality.prompt.keep.description: Android phone and TV: button on the buffering prompt that keeps the current quality.

bufferingQuality.prompt.lower.description: Android phone and TV: button on the buffering prompt that reduces the video quality.

bufferingQuality.prompt.title.description: Android phone and TV: title of the player pill that appears when playback keeps stalling, with buttons to lower or keep quality.

bufferingQuality.restore.description: Android phone and TV: button in the player that returns video to the quality that was lowered automatically.

changeAccount.addAccount.description: Android phone: button on the Change account screen that starts signing in with another account.

changeAccount.current.description: Android phone: small badge on the Change account screen marking the account currently in use.

changeAccount.menu.description: Android phone: profile menu item that opens the Change account screen.

changeAccount.moreBelow.description: Android phone: hint on the Change account screen that the list scrolls and has more accounts below.

changeAccount.signInOn.description: Android phone: button on the Change account screen to sign in on a server. {server}: the server's display name.

changeAccount.title.description: Android phone: title of the Change account screen.

status.comingSoon.description: Android phone and TV: placeholder text on a feature screen that is not built yet.

status.emptyGeneric.description: Android phone: generic empty-state message on a list or screen with no content.

status.errorGeneric.description: Android phone and TV: generic error message when loading or an action failed.

status.loading.description: Android phone and TV: generic loading indicator text.

introSkip.pill.skip.description: Android phone and TV: button over the video during a show's intro that jumps past the intro.

introSkip.pill.undo.description: Android phone and TV: button shown briefly after skipping an intro, to go back and watch it.

introSkip.pill.undoCaption.description: Android phone and TV: caption shown with the Watch Intro button, saying the intro was skipped automatically.

loginReplace.body.description: Android phone: body of the dialog on the sign-in screen asking whether to replace an expired account. {new_account}: the username just signed in; {old_account}: the username of the expired account that would be signed out.

loginReplace.confirm.description: Android phone: confirm button of the replace-account dialog; signs out the expired account.

loginReplace.failed.description: Android phone: error in the replace-account dialog when signing out the old account failed. {account}: the username of the expired account.

loginReplace.keep.description: Android phone: button of the replace-account dialog that keeps both accounts.

loginReplace.title.description: Android phone: title of the dialog asking whether to replace an expired account. {account}: the username of the expired account.
